title: Lesson file front matter
description: The front matter of one lesson file in lessons/ (#2771): what a box learned, apart from the decision it may sit beside. The Markdown body after the front matter is free-form detail. Values stay within what YAML and JSON share.

schema.description: Format version of this file. Bumped only by a change to this schema.

id.description: Stable id: a lowercase prefix, a dash and three or more digits. Never reused, never renumbered.

title.description: Short topic: what the lesson is about, in a few words.

state.description: proposed: written, not yet checked. confirmed: a person checked it still holds. superseded: a later, more precise lesson replaced it. withdrawn: turned out wrong, and never confirmed.

source.description: Where the lesson was first recorded: a row of an issue's table, the workspace itself when no issue holds it, or a harness session when neither does. Each form may also say where the proposal came from: the fields via, client, harness, model, session, turns and transcript.

situation.description: What happened: the incident, the surprising result, or the thing that turned out not to work.

learned.description: What was learned from it, stated so a later reader can act on it.

derived_from.description: The record or session this lesson was drawn from: a decision, work, constraint, preference or lesson id, or a review session id. At least one entry.

proposed_by.description: Who proposed this lesson: the name chant workspace records new --by or the MCP records-new tool's by wrote, for a lesson that opened proposed (#2756). Null or absent when nobody named a proposer, or the lesson opened straight into a later state. Never cleared by a later confirm or supersession.

confirmed_by.description: Who confirmed the lesson still holds. A forge login. Null until confirmed.

confirmed_on.description: When it was confirmed, as YYYY-MM-DD. Quoted, so YAML reads it as a string. Null until confirmed.

evidence.description: The research, incident reports and workspace files behind the lesson. A public link carries a url; a file in the workspace carries a path and the hash of its bytes (#2549). May be empty.

supersedes.description: Earlier lessons this one replaces with a more precise account. Takes effect once this lesson is confirmed or superseded (#2524 D4).

workspacePath.description: A path from the workspace root, with / separators: no leading /, no . or .. segment, no empty segment, no backslash and no trailing /.

as_of.description: When the linked text was read, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Lets a reader flag evidence that changed afterwards.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the linked content, once evidence is pinned by hash (#2555). Null until then.

evidencePin.description: A file in the workspace, pinned by the hash of its bytes. chant workspace records reports a file that changed or went missing since.

path.description: The file, from the workspace root. It sits inside a member, such as design/screens/home.json.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file's bytes when the lesson was written. chant workspace records pin <path> prints it.

as_of.description: When the file was read, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

derivedRef.description: A record id in any of the reference workspace's kinds (decision, work, constraint, preference or lesson), or a review session id.

sourceIssue.description: A row of a table in an issue.

row.description: The row's topic cell, verbatim, including any revision marker.

revision.description: The design revision that last changed this row, such as "v8". Null when the row carries no marker.

sourceWorkspace.description: A lesson learned in the workspace, with no issue behind it.

member.description: The workspace member the lesson came from, by its name in the declaration.

session.description: The id of the session the lesson came from, as the member names it, or the harness's session with the chant session record it was held in. Null or absent when there was none.

issue.description: An issue the lesson relates to, when there is one.

sourceHarness.description: A lesson proposed in a harness session, with no issue row or workspace member behind it. It says how it arrived, in via, and may say the rest of where the proposal came from.

issue.description: An issue the lesson relates to, when there is one.

sourceVia.description: How the record reached the workspace: cli, a person or script at chant workspace records new; mcp, a harness through chant serve mcp, which fills this and client itself; harvest, a transcript read after the fact. Data about the proposal, not trust.

sourceClient.description: What wrote the record: the MCP client's clientInfo, or the CLI.

sourceHarnessId.description: The harness the lesson was proposed in, such as claude-code, codex, gemini-cli, opencode, fountain or hud.

sourceModel.description: The model id the harness reports.

sourceSession.description: The session the lesson was drawn up in: its id as a string, or an object with the harness's session or conversation id and the chant session record it was held in. Null when there was none.

id.description: The harness's session or conversation id.

record.description: The id of the chant session record the lesson was held in.

sourceTurns.description: The turns of the session the lesson was made in, from and to, counted as the harness counts them. to is not before from.

sourceTranscript.description: The session's transcript, pinned by a path or URI and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of its bytes, never copied into the record. A path is absolute, starts ~/ from the home directory, or starts at the workspace root; of URIs, only file: ones are read.
